item.text: I found the pagination flaw: it treats a short page of returned items as end-of-scan, even though the gateway advances through stored rows that may include deleted records. I’m changing termination to follow the gateway’s `next` cursor and adding an invoice regression case alongside the existing project coverage.

item.text:
Fixed invoice pagination so the exporter follows the gateway’s `next` cursor even when deleted records make a page shorter than `pageSize`. Added a regression case for `i-1` active, `i-2` deleted, and `i-3` active.

`npm test` couldn’t run because this project has no `test` script in `package.json`.
